title: chat_message
description: Emitted by the plugin when a player sends a chat message. Emitted on receipt, so a message is reported exactly once — the chat window's backlog redraw (which happens on every race scene reload) does not re-emit it. Check chat_capture_mode in session_started: if it is 'Legacy' the plugin could not install the receive-side gate and the backlog may be replayed, in which case dedupe on (session_id, chat_id).

chat_id.description: Monotonic per chat message within the session, never reset. (session_id, chat_id) is a stable dedupe key, and unlike event_ordinal — which restarts each race — it orders messages across race boundaries.

self.description: True when the bot sent this message itself. The bot's own announcements come back through the same path as player chat; servers that treat chat as input should ignore these rather than react to themselves.
